specifications.Assembly Instructions Description: Lay out tent fabric flat. Insert poles through fabric sleeves. Secure corners with stakes. Tension webbing. Stake out tent.

bullets: FAST & EASY SETUP – INTEGRATED SLEEVE-POLE SYSTEM: The Naturehike 1 person backpacking tent is designed for efficient setup in changing weather conditions. Simply lay it flat, assemble the poles, insert them through the color-coded sleeves, secure to the corner grommets, tension the webbing, and stake it out. The integrated structure enables quick and controlled solo pitching while maintaining proper frame alignment.

ULTRALIGHT CAMPING TENT – 3.53 LB TOTAL WEIGHT: Total weight: 3.53 lb, Packed size: 4.7 × 15.4 in. Engineered for the ideal balance of durability and portability, this Jiling UL ultralight camping tent enhances fabric strength and structural stability while remaining compact for backpacking and trekking.

EXPANDED INTERIOR WITH DEDICATED GEAR STORAGE: Inner dimensions: 82.7 × 35.4 × 39.4 in, Interior area: 20.34 sq ft, Vestibule area: 5.9 sq ft. The extended sleeping length and single side-entry design provide comfortable solo space, while the vestibule offers organized gear storage.

15D DOUBLE RIPSTOP FABRIC – ENHANCED WEATHER PROTECTION: Upgraded 15D double-ripstop nylon fly and floor with a 3000mm+ waterproof rating. Includes a 210T polyester footprint (PU 5000mm+). Designed for improved abrasion resistance and reliable performance in rain, wind, and cold conditions.

X-CROSS STRUCTURE – LEVEL 8 WIND-TESTED STABILITY: Two Yuksom UL φ8.5mm aluminum alloy poles form a reinforced X-cross structure to improve load distribution and wind resistance. Includes: aluminum V-stakes x 12, reflective guy lines x 4. The single side-entry door and five ventilation windows promote balanced airflow while maintaining structural stability in demanding condition
